messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: high error rate -> inference runtime us-west-2. Affected model: redwood-7b-quant-v2. Error spike started at 2026-03-17T09:12:12Z. Alerts: rate_errors>5% for 3m, p95 latency >1s. Link: https://dash.company/internal/alerts/4977778888

sam: oncall here, looking now. seeing 12% 5xx across hostpool: infer-gpu-{12..18}.

morgan: thanks — are we seeing KV cache evictions? recent rollout of quant profile went live ~09:10 UTC.

lee: KV metrics: cache_hit_rate dropped 92% -> 14% around 09:11:30. batch queue length surged, a lot of small requests stacking.

maya: confirmed—batcher backlog triggered timeouts to backend connectors. Some requests retried which amplified load.

sam: immediate mitigation plan: 1) pause quant profile rollout (canary) 2) enable fallback to fp16 variant 3) increase batching workers temporarily. I can pause rollout if someone confirms control plane path.

morgan: I'm on the rollout switch. Pausing canary now. 09:18 UTC -> pause issued.

sam: rolling traffic to fp16 fallback now, will route new requests to redwood-7b-fp16-stable.

lee: bumped batch worker count +20% on us-west-2; watching queue.

maya: reducing retry multiplier in frontend to 0.5 to avoid amplification.

jordan: heads-up from CS: two customers reported timeouts on embed endpoints. We'll draft comms after impact assessment.

sam: early results: p95 latency back down to 220ms, error rate at 1.8% and decreasing. KV hit rate recovering slowly (now 45%).

morgan: good — leaving canary paused. We'll snapshot config and roll back quant artifacts from the canary hosts. Filing follow-ups.

maya: creating incident ticket INC-4921 for post-incident tracking. Adding initial timeline + links.

sam: quick log snippet from one affected host (09:11:22):
```
E inference/runtime.cpp:320 kv_cache_miss_rate=0.87 batch_wait_ms=312 p95_latency_ms=1389
W quant/loader.cpp:78 fallback_on_oom=true - attempted load quant profile v2 -> increased memory pressure
```

morgan: note: the quant v2 introduced slightly different attention kernel scheduling which lowered KV cache prefetch effectiveness — hypothesis: cache keys reshuffled -> cold misses.

lee: action items I have: audit eviction policy and add short-term rule to pin frequent prefixes for 6h. owner: lee. ETA: 2026-03-17T12:00Z.

sam: action items I have: verify rollback complete and monitor canary hosts for residual traffic. owner: sam. ETA: 2026-03-17T10:00Z.

morgan: action items I have: run binary diff of quant artifacts, reproduce locally and propose safe quant fallback (v1 compat) and a stricter rollout gating. owner: morgan. ETA: 2026-03-18T17:00Z.

maya: action items I have: draft customer impact email + internal postmortem doc skeleton, schedule postmortem meeting. owner: maya. ETA: 2026-03-17T16:00Z.

jordan: I'll collect affected customer list and churn risk notes. owner: jordan. ETA: 2026-03-17T14:00Z.

maya: scheduling postmortem: propose 2026-03-18 16:00 UTC (30m). Can people confirm availability? Link: https://calendar.company/event/pm-4977778888

sam: +1
morgan: +1
lee: +1
jordan: +1

maya: notes for postmortem scope: timeline, root cause hypothesis (quant+kv interaction), mitigation effectiveness, rollout gating policy changes, and KPIs to monitor (kv_hit_rate, batch_queue_len, p95_latency).

morgan: recommendation for immediate follow-ups: 1) add synthetic KV-warmup step to quant rollout 2) add gating on kv_hit_rate within first 10m 3) automate rollback if batch_queue_len > threshold.

lee: I'll open ops ticket OPS-2312 for eviction pin and short-term hotkey rule.

sam: I'll add monitoring alert to catch early cache-cold patterns during rollouts.

maya: INC-4921 updated with action items + owners. Closing pager for now, we have recovered and traffic is stable. Will track remediation in OPS + INC tickets. :white_check_mark:

jordan: customer comms draft will go to legal + support for review, targeting send window 2026-03-17 18:00 UTC.

morgan: leaving this thread but will post follow-ups in eng-runtime and release channels for the patch plan.

sam: thanks all — great triage. We'll cover details tomorrow in postmortem.

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> monitoring. Resolved at 2026-03-17T09:38:20Z. Logs archived: https://logs.company/4977778888
